verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਮੈ ਤਨਿਕ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਸਿਆਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: preetam kee putaree mai tanik taarikaa siaam taa ko pratibi(n)b til tilak tiralok ko ||

en.bdb: When the True Guru casts a sight of grace on the seeker woman, the thin black star-like line in the pupil of my beloved True Guru has cast a very subtle image on the face of the seeker woman that is adoring and beseeming like a mole in the three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਦਨ ਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਬਨਾਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਾਮਦੇਵ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: banitaa badhan par pragaT banai raakhio kaamadhev koT loT poT avilok ko ||

en.bdb: That subtle image of the star like shinning line has made beauty so conspicuous and astonishing that millions of cupids are becoming restless. Heaving cold sighs and lamenting, she expresses her distressed state and asks how could anyone live when the weapon of separation had penetrated deep into her heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਛਬਿ ਸਕਲ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕੋ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: koTin koTaan roop kee anoop roop chhab sakal si(n)gaar ko si(n)gaar sarab thok ko ||

en.bdb: The unique beauty as a result of that mole cannot be matched by millions of beautiful forms. The beauty of that mole is beyond the beauty of all adoring things of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਿਲ ਕੀ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋਕ ਕੋ ॥੨੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa til kee atul sobhaa surasatee koT maan bha(n)g dhiaan kok ko ||213||

en.bdb: By virtue of a little kindness of the True Guru, the fame and glory of that miniscule mole is infinite. It is capable of shattering the pride of millions of goddesses of beauty. (213)
